tasks.title: Ship memory-only retained Run admission and GC
tasks.objective: Implement the accepted 128-record memory-only Registry ceiling through one reservation, pin, collection-fence, and exact replacement owner before physical Backend mutation.
tasks.outcome: A memory-only daemon can churn indefinitely without exceeding 128 retained or projected Runs, losing protected owners, or retaining stale creation-key mappings.
acceptance: Start, Fork, and tmux import reserve projected Registry capacity before physical launch or Control startup and return run_capacity without mutation when no eligible terminal candidate exists.
Retained and Collecting linearize under one Registry truth; List and Status copy, while Attach, control, and fresh Fork pin atomically or fail explicitly.

One deterministic terminal candidate and its exact operation-key mapping are fenced and removed together; live, pinned, reader, waiter, input-drain, tmux-control, persistence-transition, and UnpublishedCleanupOwner entries are never collected.
Post-collection public errors, lineage, replay loss, retry convergence, key reuse, cap-one Fork, reverse publication, shutdown, and 127-to-129 races match the generation-6 contract.
Persistent managers keep their legacy retained publication path and emit no collection capacity result until T-003 closes exact durable replacement.
No background actor, TTL, public delete API, Session identity, Backend framework, or second reservation truth is added.

verification.proves: Memory admission, owner races, exact removal, key reuse, public errors, tmux import, and repository regressions pass.

tasks.title: Bound unclassified native waiter failure
tasks.objective: Give an unclassified direct-child try_wait error one bounded fail-closed owner disposition instead of polling every 20 ms forever or fabricating process exit.
tasks.outcome: A lost native child-wait authority stops consuming CPU, never signals a cached PID, remains explicit to clients, and has defined key and collection semantics.
acceptance: Before implementation, one reviewed owner-local contract fixes the unique internal and public disposition of an unclassified try_wait error without assuming the underlying io::Error is transient or permanent.

The bounded disposition ends the 20-ms busy loop, closes live control, retains the child handle or transfers it to an explicit fail-stop owner until its safety contract is satisfied, and never fabricates reap or falls back to cached-PID signalling.
Reader drain, terminal publication, attachment delivery, persistence, restart, shutdown, and later collection remain fail-closed under the chosen disposition.
A deterministic fake-Child seam proves bounded poll count, no busy loop, no discarded live handle, no duplicate terminal publication, no extra signal, and the single selected disposition.
The change remains inside native waiter/control ownership and adds no process-tree policy, supervisor actor, or process adoption.

verification.proves: Unclassified waiter failure, native lifecycle, control fencing, persistence, shutdown, and repository regressions pass.

tasks.title: Close persistent retained Run replacement
tasks.objective: Implement the smallest persistence-owned exact replacement whose WAL and page-cost admission is proven before launch and whose COMMIT disposition cannot reopen a key or duplicate a Run.
tasks.outcome: Persistent mode supports bounded churn across restart while old candidates and the new Run recover as one pre- or post-COMMIT state.
acceptance: A reviewed persistence-owned WAL and page-cost rule bounds the exact candidate set before physical launch; unprovable or over-budget requests return run_capacity before mutation.
The actor distinguishes NotCommitted, Committed, and fail-stop CommitUnknown; only NotCommitted restores candidates and Committed drives one infallible Registry replacement.
Candidate rows, replay, metadata accounting, and byte-exact creation keys change in one SQLite transaction; crash fixtures recover all old candidates or only the new Run.
Startup normalization and ordinary creation stay inside frozen record, metadata, replay, database, WAL, and SHM ceilings.
No general transaction API, migration layer, durable collection ticket, pending tombstone, or PID adoption is added.

verification.proves: Persistent admission, exact replacement, COMMIT ambiguity, restart, key convergence, and repository regressions pass.

tasks.title: Qualify retained-state plateau
tasks.objective: Only after memory-only admission, bounded waiter failure, persistent replacement, and Kernel review close, prove bounded records, replay, resources, owner counts, and retry identity across sustained churn and restart.
tasks.outcome: Source-bound evidence demonstrates a stable retained-state plateau without budget relaxation, hidden duplicate starts, or shortened soak.
acceptance: The harness consumes reliability-gc-contract.json as the sole workload, seed, helper, owner, sampling, resource, and time-budget truth.
T-001, T-002, T-003, and the T-006 correction review are done before canonical qualification begins; a partial implementation or superseded T-004 conclusion is never presented as the two-mode result.

Both modes fill 128 records and complete at least three full 128-Run turnover windows with exact retries, cumulative physical-start counts, bounded candidate work, and zero quiescent transient owners.
Persistent restart preserves the exact retained Run/key/replay tuple set and resumes churn without duplicate launch or mixed COMMIT state.
Maximum replay pressure and the ordinary nightly soak satisfy frozen CPU, RSS, descriptor, thread, child, attachment, reader, waiter, and input-drain rules.
Historical receipts, hashes, workloads, numeric margins, and frozen budgets remain unchanged; no shorter soak or post-result rebaseline replaces them.
A clean exact revision passes scripts/check.sh and the canonical nightly reliability profile with receipts and unchanged budget hashes retained.

verification.proves: Retained-state correctness and repository regressions pass.
Canonical churn, pressure, restart, plateau, and unchanged-budget evidence pass.
The exact source, raw series, receipt hashes, and residual Kernel limits are bound to closure.

tasks.title: Correct and complete the bounded Run-Kernel review
tasks.objective: Restore honest Tracker truth after T-004 was closed with only Gate-stability evidence, then independently review the shipped Run owner boundaries and close only P0/P1 defects required by the finite Kernel oracle.
tasks.outcome: The bounded Kernel review map, independent findings, and Tracker completion agree without discarding T-004's valid historical Gate evidence or expanding adjacent product scope.
acceptance: Independent reviewers cover native lifecycle, Registry and keys, replay and attachment, protocol and clients, fork provenance, persistence, security, and resource ownership.
Every P0/P1 finding in a shipped Kernel claim gains an executable regression and independent re-review; P2 findings are recorded or routed unless they block a required Gate.
The review explicitly checks product drift, owner count, lock order, failure disposition, public errors, SSOT, complexity, naming, and deterministic evidence.

Fork review covers Kernel capability, caller-materialized plans, lineage, and fail-closed enforcement only; Integration-owned semantic provenance remains in the SDK host and is not reimplemented here.
Tmux version qualification, activation, packaging, platforms, release, and peer performance remain with their neighboring Features.

verification.proves: The bounded Kernel review map, attributable reviewers, findings, dispositions, and exact evidence are auditable and agree with current Tracker truth.
All required Kernel corrections and ordinary regressions pass.
